sections.introduction: Neelibhringadi Taila (Oil) is an Ayurvedic and herbal hair oil, which is a useful product to improve the quality of hair, to treat split hairs, premature graying and baldness.
sections.ingredients:
Neeli swarasa ( Indigofera tinctoria ) – Juice extract or decoction of – 768 ml 
 Bhringraj swarasa ( Eclipta alba ) – Juice extract or decoction of – 768 ml 
 Shatakratulata (Karnasphota) ( Cardiospermum halicacabum) – decoction – 768 ml 
 Dhatri (Amla) ( Emblica officinalis ) – 768 ml 
 Aja ksheera (Goat milk) – 768 ml 
 Nalikera Ksheera (coconut) – 768 ml 
 Mahishiksheera – Buffalo milk – 768 ml 
 Dhenudbhava (Cow milk) – 768 ml 
 Taila (Coconut oil) – 768 ml 
 Yashti (Licorice) ( Glycyrrhiza glabra ) – 32 g 
 Gunjamoola ( Abrus precatorius ) – Root of – 32 g 
 Anjana ( Berberis aristata ) – Aqueous extract of – 32 g 

 Method of Preparation 
 Take juices, animal milks and base oil (coconut or sesame oil). Prepare herbal paste using water or milk. Then, mix all ingredients and heat the mixture till only oil is left behind. The Leftover oil is Neelibhringadi Taila (Oil). 
 Leave the Neelibhringadi Taila (Oil) with herbal residues for its natural cooling for 24 to 48 hours. After all this filter Neelibhringadi Oil and remove the residues. Finally Neelibhringadi Taila (Oil) is ready to use.
sections.how_to_use_it:
This oil is for external application only. 
 Its application over the scalp followed by its gentle massage for five minutes. 
 It can be applied during night and hair wash can be done in the morning. 
 It can also be applied in the morning, half an hour before a head bath. 
 For daily basis small quantities can be applied. 
 In case of its use for a very long period of time take advice from the Doctor.
sections.therapeutic_uses:
This oil is useful in treating premature greying, split hairs as well as hair loss. 
 It is also a helpful treatment in case of baldness or hair loss. 
 Also help in controlling dandruff and scalp itching. 
 It can even improve the quality, smoothness and shine of the hair. 
 Also indicated in case of scalp infections, scalp acne and tinea capitis (fungal infection) etc.
sections.contraindications_side_effects:
No side effects have been noticed with external application of this oil. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

Neelibhringadi Taila (Oil) – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Sahasra Yoga, Taila Yoga Prakarana – 38. 
 Introduction 
 Neelibhringadi Taila (Oil) is an Ayurvedic and herbal hair oil, which is a useful product to improve the quality of hair, to treat split hairs, premature graying and baldness. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Neeli swarasa ( Indigofera tinctoria ) – Juice extract or decoction of – 768 ml 
 Bhringraj swarasa ( Eclipta alba ) – Juice extract or decoction of – 768 ml 
 Shatakratulata (Karnasphota) ( Cardiospermum halicacabum) – decoction – 768 ml 
 Dhatri (Amla) ( Emblica officinalis ) – 768 ml 
 Aja ksheera (Goat milk) – 768 ml 
 Nalikera Ksheera (coconut) – 768 ml 
 Mahishiksheera – Buffalo milk – 768 ml 
 Dhenudbhava (Cow milk) – 768 ml 
 Taila (Coconut oil) – 768 ml 
 Yashti (Licorice) ( Glycyrrhiza glabra ) – 32 g 
 Gunjamoola ( Abrus precatorius ) – Root of – 32 g 
 Anjana ( Berberis aristata ) – Aqueous extract of – 32 g 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Take juices, animal milks and base oil (coconut or sesame oil). Prepare herbal paste using water or milk. Then, mix all ingredients and heat the mixture till only oil is left behind. The Leftover oil is Neelibhringadi Taila (Oil). 
 Leave the Neelibhringadi Taila (Oil) with herbal residues for its natural cooling for 24 to 48 hours. After all this filter Neelibhringadi Oil and remove the residues. Finally Neelibhringadi Taila (Oil) is ready to use. 
 How to Use it? 
 
 This oil is for external application only. 
 Its application over the scalp followed by its gentle massage for five minutes. 
 It can be applied during night and hair wash can be done in the morning. 
 It can also be applied in the morning, half an hour before a head bath. 
 For daily basis small quantities can be applied. 
 In case of its use for a very long period of time take advice from the Doctor. 
 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 
 This oil is useful in treating premature greying, split hairs as well as hair loss. 
 It is also a helpful treatment in case of baldness or hair loss. 
 Also help in controlling dandruff and scalp itching. 
 It can even improve the quality, smoothness and shine of the hair. 
 Also indicated in case of scalp infections, scalp acne and tinea capitis (fungal infection) etc. 
 
 Contraindications/Side Effects 
 No side effects have been noticed with external application of this oil. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
